messages:
maria: Quick update — we hit 25M monthly tokens 🚀. To celebrate, a roaming coffee cart will be in the lot at 11:30 with a small pastry spread. Grab one and say hi!
kevin: YAS! Oat milk latte, extra cinnamon please ☕️✨
olivia: I made a tiny poster for the kitchen with the traffic spike chart. It looks like a mountain and I am very proud. Will pin it up.
ash: Can someone take my standup slot for 2 mins? I want to do a micro-demo at 12:00 and ring a bell if all checks pass 🔔
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Prod deploy complete: v2026.3.2 — smoke tests green, no regressions.
sam: Stickers? We need victory stickers. I volunteer to design a cheeky "I survived launch" badge 😅
maria: Raffle at 3pm in lobby — I reserved a parking spot as the prize. Bring a friend, come say thanks to infra for keeping 99.98% P95 latency today. Huge props.
kevin: Cake or cookies? Olivia, what's the pastry situation? 📸
olivia: Cake is banana-choc (safe pick). Will post a pic in #general in 10.
ash: Mini scavenger: I hid a tiny paper flag somewhere near my desk. Find it and the finder gets first raffle ticket (and a houseplant obligation) 🌱
sam: Karaoke tonight? React with :microphone: to vote. Low-pressure, absolutely no judgement.
maria: P.S. If you made quick eval prompts during the surge, drop them in #docs. Short prompts help us catch regressions quickly. Thanks team, proud of the hustle ❤️
